info.name: Generative Marketing Collateral API
info.description:
ML6 Case 2 — two-endpoint API: upload two companies' context PDFs, then generate a tailored, factually-grounded B2B article as layout-valid structured JSON.

BASE URL is preset to the deployed Cloud Run service (edit the `baseUrl` collection variable for local: http://localhost:8000).

AUTH: in demo mode no token is needed. When the service runs with AUTH_MODE=google, set the `token` collection variable to a Google ID token:
  gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences={{baseUrl}}
(The collection sends it as a Bearer token on every request.)

TYPICAL FLOW:
  1. Upload sender PDF  (pick sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf)
  2. Upload receiver PDF (pick sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf)
  3. Get briefs — poll until both sender and receiver are non-null
  4. Generate — returns 202 + job_id (auto-saved to a variable by a test script)
  5. Poll generation — until status=done; ArticleJSON is under `result`.

request.description: Lists the layout templates (one_pager_v1, two_column_v1). Also the recommended liveness check — use this instead of /healthz, which Google's front end shadows on *.run.app.

Upload the SENDER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/sender_nimbus_ai.pdf. Parsed asynchronously into a typed brief; returns a job_id. (Enable the X-Tenant-ID header to exercise multi-tenancy.)
Upload the RECEIVER company's PDF. In the 'files' form field, choose sample_data/receiver_vanguard_freight.pdf.
Returns the stored sender/receiver briefs. Poll until BOTH are non-null before generating.

body.raw: {"pair_id": "{{pair_id}}", "prompt": "Show how Nimbus cuts Vanguard's idle fleet hours and improves on-time delivery", "template_id": "one_pager_v1"}

request.description: Starts generation. Returns 202 + job_id immediately (never blocks on the model). A test script auto-saves job_id to the collection variable so the Poll request just works. Enable the Idempotency-Key header to make retries return the same job.
Poll until status=done. The finished ArticleJSON (blocks, confidence, constraints, faithfulness, token/cost) is under `result`.
Status of an upload/parse job — use the job_id returned by an Upload request.
Fetch an image/logo extracted during parsing (asset id without file extension).
